summary: Inline ghost completion for native terminal input
expected: Render a caller-provided suggestion suffix with shared terminal tokens while preserving native editing and horizontal scrolling.
acceptanceCriteria: Only show a matching suffix while focused at the end of a text input, without selection or IME composition.
Hide suggestions for password, disabled and readonly inputs; never write suggestions into the native value.
XCA reuses session completions and history, accepts with ArrowRight and retains Tab cycling.

consumers.scenario: User requested terminal ghost completion with a screenshot reference.

resolution: Implemented suggestion in UiTerminalPrompt and shared terminal CSS, wired XCA TerminalSession.suggest and ArrowRight acceptance. Vue terminal unit tests: 7 passed; XCA core tests: 14 passed; XCA terminal-completion Playwright: 6 passed, including light/dark and 390/1440px horizontal scrolling. XCA typecheck, production build, terminal boundary, shared stylelint and contracts passed. Evidence: packages/vue/src/terminal.test.ts; XCA-Portal/tests/e2e/terminal-completion.spec.ts; docs/terminal-composition.md. Visual approval and publication remain pending.
